title: Paired bluetooth devices are listed as "Available" when their bluetooth adapter is disabled and multiple adapters are present
line: With several Bluetooth adapters, devices paired to a turned off adapter now appear under "Unavailable" instead of "Available".
explanation: The device list shared by the Bluetooth applet and the KCM sorts devices into Blocked, Connected and Available sections and never looked at whether the device's adapter is powered. With a single adapter this is hidden by the "Bluetooth is disabled" placeholder, but with two adapters and one turned off, that adapter's paired devices were shown as Available with a Connect button. DevicesProxyModel now gives those devices an "Unavailable" section and sorts it below Available (above Blocked); it updates live when the adapter is turned on or off.

commits.message:
applet: list devices of a turned off adapter as unavailable

With more than one adapter, paired devices of an adapter that is turned
off were still listed under "Available" although they can't be used. Put
them in their own "Unavailable" section, sorted below available devices.

BUG: 510884

media.caption: Bluetooth KCM: the headset paired to the turned off internal adapter is listed under Available
Bluetooth KCM: the headset is now under Unavailable, below the dongle's speaker
Bluetooth applet: same, the headset is under Available
Bluetooth applet: the headset is under Unavailable

reviews.text: The DevicesProxyModel changes cleanly categorize devices on powered-off adapters under a separate Unavailable section sorted below Available and update live when adapter power changes. However, both the KCM and applet still display an enabled, clickable Connect button on these Unavailable devices (which will always fail while the adapter is off) and give no indication that the device is unavailable specifically because its adapter is disabled.
changes: Disable (or hide) the Connect action in both the Bluetooth applet (src/applet/qml/DeviceItem.qml) and the Bluetooth KCM when the device's adapter is powered off (!AdapterPowered).

Indicate to the user why the device is unavailable (for example via the subtitle, section heading, or disabled Connect button tooltip mentioning that the adapter is turned off), matching the reporter's request.

reviews.text: Right place and a clean change: DevicesProxyModel now uses AdapterPoweredRole for the section and sort (descending sort, so the new block lands between Available and Blocked), and the KCM/applet screenshots show the headset moving to an Unavailable section, updating live. But the after screenshots show the device under "Unavailable" still offering an enabled Connect button, which contradicts the section title and can only fail with the adapter off; the reporter also asked for the devices to be marked as unavailable because their adapter is disabled, and the bare header gives no reason. A maintainer/VDG review would very likely ask for this to be consistent before merging.
changes: In the applet and KCM delegates, disable or hide the Connect action for devices whose adapter is not powered (or make it turn that adapter on), instead of leaving a Connect button that cannot work.
Tell the user why the device is unavailable, e.g. a subtitle like "Adapter turned off" (or name the section after the adapter state), as the reporter requested.
Update before/after media to show the final delegate state.
